title: Tetris Music Disc Pack
description: Nintendo Music Pack Series: VOLUME VI
body:
This Data and Resource Pack collection adds 12 craftable music discs from the Game Boy & NES releases of Tetris.

### TRACKLIST
All track names are sourced from the Nintendo Music app.

**_GAME BOY_**
- Title Screen
- A-Type (Early Version)
- A-Type
- B-Type
- C-Type
- 25 Lines Cleared
- Ending: High 5
- Rocket Launch
- Game Over
- Name Entry
- 2 Player: Danger
- 2 Player: Final Results

**_NES_**
- MUSIC-1
- MUSIC-2
- MUSIC-3
- 25 Lines Cleared
- Ending
- Name Entry

DISCLAIMER: Due to these games not having an official soundtrack release outside of Nintendo Music, song length and audio quality may not 100% reflect how it appears on the app.

### CRAFTING GUIDE
A smithing table is required to obtain discs added in these packs. The recipes are displayed in the Advancements tab, which unlocks when you obtain any Music Disc and either a Block of Emerald for the Game Boy version or a Block of Diamond for the NES version. The Advancement tab shows a checklist of each song with the required *"addition"* item needed to obtain it as the Advancement icon.
